prompts.arc: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game VFX flipbook spritesheet. Create original ink brush martial arts combat effects. Transparent background with actual alpha. Square canvas divided mathematically into 4 columns and 4 rows of equal cells, 16 frames in reading order. No grid lines, no text, no characters, no weapon, no paper, no checkerboard. Each frame must remain fully within its cell with 12 percent transparent margin, exactly identical pivot and framing across all 16 cells. Sharp graphic dry-brush ink, ragged torn edges, internal negative-space slits, wispy bristle tips, tiny separated ink shards. Dense near-black ink silhouette plus a crisp thin icy white/very pale blue accent along the leading edge. Minimal glow. Readable at 64 or 96 pixels per cell, intentional broad shapes, no dense tiny fuzzy noise. Cohesive high quality stylized realtime combat VFX. Animation must visibly EVOLVE: initial short stroke -> fast extended powerful full form -> tearing into separated pieces -> final sparse fragments. Not 16 identical stamp poses. Preserve strong forward movement and weight. Specific subject: one right-bulging C-shaped crescent brush slash. Its empty center stays at the center of every cell. The crescent occupies the right half and top/bottom quadrants around that center; two tapered tips on the left, bold bowed outer edge on the right. A 200-degree OPEN arc, never a closed ring. Frame 1 tiny mark at lower-left tip; frames 2-5 progressively sweeping around the right side upward, frame 6-8 full curved blade with pointed ends and dry-brush filaments, frames 9-12 progressively tear the C shape into long separated curved shards, frames 13-16 shrinking scattered ink fragments following the same curve. Thin white leading edge is secondary to the black body. Side view, flat 2D sprites. Each frame same center and scale.

Remain in the middle 40 percent of the cell vertically throughout. NOT crescents, NOT curved, no circular explosion, no star. Always left to right.

interaction: 돌진 원투 0.53초 정지에서 수묵 on/off가 시점·정지를 유지
기존 주먹선 선택은 수묵 on에서 비활성화하고 off에서 복원
이동 포함 off는 효과를 숨기고 on에서 선호 복원
타격 효과 off는 impact 0개와 수묵 궤적 1개를 표시
샌드백 원투의 connected=false인 두 번째 타격에는 충돌 효과가 없고 궤적만 유지
팔꿈치 전용 그림 off는 같은 정지 시점에서 수묵 2→0, 충격 1→0으로 바꾸고 샌드백 비활성화
어퍼컷의 면 궤적 선호도 수묵 on/off에서 복원되며 0.39초 정지 유지
호격권·순옥살·보류 앞 밀어차기·뒤공중돌기·마시기를 각각 선택하면 수묵 선택 숨김, inkEnabled=false, inkCount=0
미지원 동작에서 공격으로 돌아오면 수묵 선호 복원
